scope: Phase B core legs: authored F32 IR (B0(b)), graph checker, L2/B2-ORACLE/L3/L4, B3 core controls, B4, B5, B6. I64 extraction, L1 Wasm/V8 and the BigInt oracle are the extraction leg's evidence.
non_claims: Finite tests and evaluator agreement do not prove the compiler, the graph checker (NG-PO-B) or the evaluators (NG-PO-C) correct.
NG-PO-A..H remain open; no obligation is added to obligations.json.

run.profiles: ngraph-ir/0; ngraph-i64/0 + ngraph-f32/0; ngraph-sem/0; ngraph-facts/0; ngraph-layered/0
run.cpu: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
run.workload: B1 F1-F3; B2 vectors + 8 random graphs x 20000 vectors (48 ops) + 1000000 op pairs; B3 core controls; B4 2000 gradient samples; B5 500 steps; B6 cleanup matrix
run.resource_limits: /0 defaults: live nodes 262144, layers 16384, affine terms 4096, table 65536 / 1048576, facts 262144, graph bytes 33554432, snapshot bytes 4194304, forward scratch 67108864, backward scratch 134217728, optimizer steps 1000000

wasm_features.gc: not-applicable: CPU-only Rust legs; no Wasm executed by this harness

run.instrumentation: scratch-lease counters (crate); wall-clock seconds via std::time::Instant; no hardware counters (unsupported, not zero)
